intents.name: packages
intents.answer:
🎒 *99 Destinations Tour Packages — Inclusions & Highlights*

✅ *What is Included:*
• Hand-picked hotel / resort / heritage stay accommodation
• Meal plans as specified in your itinerary (daily breakfast/half-board)
• Dedicated private vehicle for all airport/station transfers and sightseeing
• Forest entry permits (e.g. Sasan Gir Lion Safari permits, subject to availability)
• Toll taxes, state border permits, parking, night halt charges, driver bata
• Complimentary travel insurance for safe journeys (T&C apply)
• All applicable government taxes

❌ *What is Excluded:*
• Flights/train tickets (unless booked through our air ticketing desk)
• Personal expenses, porterage, tips, laundry, monument entry fees
• Meals outside pre-set itinerary

intents.name: booking_policy
intents.answer:
📋 *99 Destinations — Booking & Cancellation Policy*

💳 *Payment Terms:*
• 50% advance payment at confirmation.
• Balance 50% due 20 days prior to departure.
• If booking within 20 days of travel, 100% advance is required.

❌ *Cancellation Policy:*
• 45+ days prior: 10% fee (90% refund)
• 15–44 days prior: 25% fee (75% refund)
• 07–14 days prior: 50% fee (50% refund)
• Within 48 hours or No Show: Non-refundable

_Note: Written cancellations accepted on working days (Mon–Sat). Sunday requests are processed on Monday._

intents.name: visa_documents
intents.answer:
🛂 *Worldwide Visa Assistance & Services*

99 Destinations provides comprehensive visa processing for all countries:
• Updated application forms, consular requirements, and latest embassy fee guidelines
• Scrutiny of documentation prior to consular submission to maximize approval chances
• Direct document delivery from consular offices straight to your doorstep
• Competitive rates with full transparency

_Note: While we ensure thorough paperwork, final visa approvals remain at the sole discretion of embassies/consulates._
